assets.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: a reusable master-reference PNG of a REAL historical award for future image generations and a family-history website.
Input image 1: the museum photograph is the exact edit target and authoritative identity reference.
Primary request: make a faithful clean photographic cutout of this exact physical award. Remove the white background and present the complete award alone, with the entire original ribbon mount, suspension ring and badge intact.
Preserve the actual object's geometry, silhouette, relative sizes, enamel patterns, metallic relief, real inscriptions, ribbon stripe colors and diagonal ribbon fold. Use the museum photograph as ground truth. Do not redesign, invent details, substitute a different award, change emblems, rewrite lettering, exaggerate age, add scratches or apply an illustration style.
Presentation: a clean catalog-quality photograph, realistic silver/gilding, natural textile weave, neutral soft diffuse light, crisp readable relief. Keep the slightly aged material character of the museum object without added stylization or cinematic grading.
Framing: portrait 2:3 PNG canvas, one full complete object centered upright. Put the complete physical object comfortably inside the frame with at least 10 percent empty transparent padding above and below, and adequate padding at the sides. No cropping, no second view, no composite scene.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha everywhere outside the physical award, and through visible openings in its hardware. Remove all white source backdrop including between rings and around folds; no white rim, black rectangle, matte, halo, glow or cast shadow. No surface, props, labels, external captions or watermark.

Identity checks: Medal For Labour Valour, the pentagonal suspension version in the museum photograph. Preserve the lilac woven ribbon with its red border stripes and actual diagonal fold. Preserve the silver circular face, red enamel five-point star, silver hammer and sickle on the star, the exact engraved words "ЗА ТРУДОВУЮ" / "ДОБЛЕСТЬ" and "СССР" in the same positions and relative sizes as in the photo.
